create_corpus_rewriter_pipeline: create a sequential corpus rewriter pipeline that chunks documents then formats each chunk
build_chunking_rewriter: build a chunking corpus rewriter that fragments documents into smaller pieces using a specified chunker
create_formatting_rewriter: create a formatting corpus rewriter that applies a consistent structure to every document in a corpus
run_no_rewriting: run a no rewriting rewriter that returns the corpus as is without any transformations
build_sequential_rewriter: build a sequential corpus rewriter that applies multiple transformations in a specific order
